column2: My hands are in dough, three people text me at once, and I can't touch my phone. Other lenses help you cook. This one answers people while you cook.
The inbox lies on the counter, right next to my work, and never covers it.

What's real here: the Lens, the card, every button, and six tests in Lens Studio. The messages and rewrites are sample data. Voice commands are wired but off in this preview, so the pinch buttons do the same job.
